title: Symmetry- and Property-Aware Crystal Generation with Reinforcement Learning for Inverse Materials Design
abstract: arXiv:2609.13468v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The inverse design of crystalline materials ultimately seeks structures with desired physical properties. However, for many functional responses, a favorable numerical value is meaningful only when supported by the symmetry of the underlying crystal. Without the appropriate crystallographic constraints, an apparent response may be ill defined, accidental, or not symmetry protected. Here we introduce SPARC, a symmetry- and property-aware reinforcement learning framework that optimizes physical objectives while preserving the structural conditions required for their realization. We demonstrate SPARC on two complementary tasks. The first targets strong uniaxial dielectric anisotropy, a tensorial response that is well defined only within appropriate crystal classes. The second maximizes the spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency, a scalar device-level objective without a prescribed symmetry class, allowing the framework to identify favor

translated_title: 基于强化学习的对称性与性质感知晶体生成方法用于逆向材料设计
translated_abstract: 逆向设计晶体材料的最终目标是获得具有理想物理性质的结构。然而，对于许多功能性响应而言，数值上理想的取值只有在底层晶体对称性的支撑下才有意义。若缺乏适当的晶体学约束，表观的响应可能定义不明确、纯属偶然，或不受对称性保护。本文提出SPARC，一个对称性与性质感知的强化学习框架，它在优化物理目标的同时保持实现这些目标所需的结构条件。我们在两个互补的任务上展示了SPARC：第一个任务针对强单轴介电各向异性，这是一种只有在适当晶类中才具有明确意义的张量响应；第二个任务最大化光谱限制最大效率，这是一个不规定对称类别的标量器件级目标，使该框架能够识别有利的结构。
tldr: SPARC框架通过对称性与性质感知的强化学习，在优化晶体材料物理性质目标的同时保持其必需的晶体对称性约束，解决了逆向设计中性质数值与晶体结构对称性脱节的问题。
en_tdlr: SPARC is a symmetry- and property-aware reinforcement learning framework that optimizes physical objectives in crystal generation while preserving the crystallographic symmetry conditions required for those properties to be well defined and meaningful.
